title: Smart Ebike Charger
description: ESP32-based smart charger for a custom 6S ebike battery pack, designed to safely use a LiHV charger on standard LiPo cells by cutting off at a timed voltage threshold that accounts for IR drop. WiFi-enabled with live web dashboard and OLED display.

assets.name: Download Firmware (.ino)
assets.description: Arduino sketch for the ESP32-C3: relay cutoff logic, hold timer, voltage calibration, web dashboard, NVS settings persistence
